title: Space bound for the timed conditional controller
statement: Let $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$ be finite-state Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $b$ be a bit, and let $T,t\in\mathbb N$. Suppose $D$ computes output $[b]$ from $x$ in exactly $T$ steps, with some amount of space. Then by time $t$, the timed conditional controller uses at most the sum of the space used by $D$ on $x$ through time $T$, the space used by the two-branch machine selecting $b$ on $x$ through time $t$, and $2$.
hypotheses_covered: $D,M_1,M_2$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
